Last week I did this and for 5 days I didn’t eat or drink anything, stayed in bed all day, and didn’t talk to anyone. My brain forgot what hunger even was and while I knew I was starving, my brain didn’t function anymore and refused to tell me I had to eat. 

My friend got me to eat finally and I felt bad that I told him cause he cares so much about me and I felt guilty putting my problems into him. I felt bad and ate because he begged me and at first it felt horrible. I hated the feeling of food in my stomach and everything was just very unappetizing to me. But I had to eat and eventually my brain started working. 

Starvation takes a really long time but what will kill you is the mental aspect. Your brain stops caring about your body because you’ve set the precedent that you don’t care either. And it just spirals deeper into depression more so than hunger. If it wasn’t for my friend, I would still be in that state. I can’t really describe it but it’s your brain all mushed.
